stemAssignment.source: No CP02 assignment exists for CIN_008; tran_son music + river_shore ambience are the gate-and-pool cues (composed, CP26/CP30) for this quiet signing-memory scene (S01: a brush hand signs a paper order in indigo; S02: a tall wooden double gate stands nearly shut, lantern-lit, a robed adult waiting with a clay water vessel; S03: Ta Van Khanh confesses beside a bamboo forest pool; pack shot prompts, CIN_008 S01/S02/S03). tran_son is the composed set's bell-led gate form, matching the scene's central gate image; river_shore is the water-edge bed for the pool. and the reveal stinger is the scene's only manifest-listed candidate stem (CIN_008_timing_v1.json).

notes: M-F CP2 palette re-mix: the VO take(s) listed under paletteRemix.changes replace the v1 draft take(s). Any v1 note below describing the canonical take's duration or overrun describes the v1 mix only and does not apply to v2.
VO window 12.5-17.5 s is PROPOSED_ANIMATIC_PLACEMENT (only CIN_001_S05 is DECIDED); all 21 windows are approved for DRAFT VO per Goi 30 D1.

VO take runs 12.5-16.052 s: 3.552 s, ending 1.448 s BEFORE the 17.5 s window end -- the take FITS inside its window (no overrun, unlike CIN_005/CIN_006). The take ends 1.948 s before the 18.00 s scene end, so no tail trim at the scene edge. The window, the take and the timing are unchanged.

Ducking depth is measured on the ducked bus against its unducked render (RMS over the full VO window vs a 2 s reference before the window). The full-window method from checkpoint 39 is retained so the depth is comparable across the CIN_003/CIN_005/CIN_007/CIN_008 mixes (a 2 s slice can understate the cut on cues whose window opening is quiet).
Ambience loop join uses a 1 s acrossfade; loopQA reports the max sample jump at the join against the bed's own 99.9th-percentile jump.
Stinger placement at 6.0 s (S02 start) is PROPOSED pending picture lock, mirroring the CIN_004 reveal at 6.0 s.
